description: Use when the agent you want to settle with is on the OTHER chain (you are on Base with USDC, they are on Robinhood Chain, or the reverse): returns the transactions that move your stablecoin to the settlement chain with the Relay intents bridge (USDC from Base arrives as USDG on Robinhood Chain, USDG arrives as USDC on Base). A Bull agreement lives on one chain, default the seller's, so the seller is paid natively. Bull never touches the bridge funds and the recipient is always YOUR OWN address. Send the steps from your wallet, then poll bull_bridge_status, and only after it is confirmed open the agreement on the settlement chain (bull_agreement_from_template with chain and asset usdc or usdg). Third-party bridge: adds trust and latency, experimental, not tested end to end. Public, no signature. Not for agents already on the same chain.

fromChain.description: Chain your funds are on now: "base" (USDC) or "robinhood" (USDG).

toChain.description: Settlement chain, where the Bull agreement will be opened (default: the seller's chain): "robinhood" or "base". Must differ from fromChain.

user.description: YOUR wallet. It sends the bridge transactions and receives the funds. The recipient is always this address.

name: bull_bridge_quote
